history: A visual joke that became a standard: the cream head sits on the dark body exactly like a poured stout.
whyItWorks: No Guinness in it at all. Coffee liqueur reads as roasted malt, which is why the illusion works on the palate too.
steps: Pour the coffee liqueur into a shot glass.
Layer by pouring each ingredient slowly over the back of a bar spoon so it floats on the one below. Aim for a clean, level head about a quarter of the glass.
techniqueNotes: The float is the whole point — pour it slowly or you have a muddy brown shot.
name: Baby Guinness
description: Coffee liqueur with Irish cream floated to look like a tiny pint.
